svg.title: First retained runtime campaign: failed targets
svg.desc: A verifier schema mistake caused the five semantic rows to fail after their actions: tasks returns pending/history, while runtime owns active/queued/limits/connections. A separate corrected diagnostic passed all 1/4/8/16/32 levels with isolation, fairness, cancellation, drain and connection bounds under 2 GiB. The original failed rows remain unchanged. All 66 campaign cleanup receipts pass, and a live check found no owned profile leftovers.
